verdict.rationale: smolagents is open-source (Apache-licensed code), agent configs/tools can be pushed to/pulled from the Hub as repos (push_to_hub/from_hub), and memory can be replayed, suggesting no lock-in of agent definitions; however there's no explicit data-export feature for runtime logs, traces, or user data in an open format beyond OpenTelemetry instrumentation. missing for 10: explicit documented data export/import feature for run history or user data, portability guarantees beyond code/tool artifacts, independent confirmation of export completeness.
